files.content: Pixel Hangman

# Pixel Hangman

A fully offline, accessible pixel-art hangman game built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests, no external assets.

## Features

- Built-in word list with random selection
- Letter buttons A–Z with keyboard accessibility
- Progressive hangman drawing on canvas (up to 6 wrong guesses)
- Win/lose messages and New Game button
- Cohesive 4-color palette, responsive down to 360px
- Visible hover, focus, and pressed states on all controls

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` — main page structure
- `style.css` — theming, layout, and control states
- `script.js` — game logic and canvas drawing

## Controls

- Click or keyboard-navigate (Tab) to letter buttons and press Enter/Space to guess
- Use the New Game button to restart at any time

## Accessibility

- All interactive controls are native buttons with labels
- `aria-live` regions announce the word state and game messages
- Focus indicators are clearly visible
- Layout works from 360px width upward
